name: curl piped directly to shell
description: curl ... | sh or | bash executes remote content with no integrity check (TOFU). Pin a checksum, download first, then verify and execute. CWE-494 (Download of Code Without Integrity Check).

name: wget piped directly to shell
description: wget -qO- ... | sh executes remote content without integrity check. Download first, verify, then execute. CWE-494 (Download of Code Without Integrity Check).

name: rm -rf with unquoted variable
description: rm -rf $DIR or rm -rf ${HOME}/... will delete the entire filesystem if the variable is empty. Always quote or validate the variable. CWE-22 (Path Traversal) / CWE-143.

name: chmod 777 / 666 world-writable
description: chmod 777 grants world rw to any user on the host. Use 750 / 640 / 600 depending on need. CWE-732 (Incorrect Permission Assignment).

name: SSH with StrictHostKeyChecking=no
description: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no accepts any host key → MITM possible on first connect. Pre-stage known_hosts or pin the public key. CWE-295 (Improper Certificate Validation).

name: eval with untrusted input
description: eval "$USER_INPUT" interprets arbitrary shell. Quote, sanitize, or avoid eval; prefer direct expansion of controlled tokens. CWE-78 (OS Command Injection).

name: curl/wget to plaintext HTTP
description: curl http://... or wget http://... transmits credentials/tokens in plaintext. Use https:// or a pinned CA. CWE-319 (Cleartext Transmission).

name: echo / printf of secrets to stdout
description: echo "$PASSWORD", printf '%s\n' "$TOKEN" — secrets land in shell history, logs, stdout captures. Mask with *** or redirect to fd. CWE-532 (Insertion of Sensitive Info into Log).

name: sudo -S reading password from stdin
description: sudo -S ... reads the password from stdin (often piped) and exposes it via pipe / process listing. Use a PAM module, keychain, or non-sudo user. CWE-212 (Info Exposure Through Error Message).

name: scp / ftp / sftp without key pinning
description: scp/ftp/sftp with default host key handling is vulnerable to MITM on first connect. Use StrictHostKeyChecking=ask and pre-staged keys. CWE-295.

name: history disabled or HISTFILE cleared in shared job
description: unset HISTFILE or histfile='' hides actions from audit; combined with admin shell it is often a persistence/anti-forensics move. Investigate if in a job script. CWE-778 (Insufficient Logging).

name: nc / netcat listener on 0.0.0.0
description: nc -l 0.0.0.0 / nc.lnk 0.0.0.0 exposes a listener to any source. Bind to 127.0.0.1 or a trusted interface. CWE-605 (Multiple Bind).
